CustomField.formula: CASE( MOD( Rep_Ownership_Date__c - DATE( 1900, 1, 7 ), 7 ), 0, Rep_Ownership_Date__c + 0 + 5, /* Sun:Rep_Ownership_Date__c+0 wknd day+5 days */ 2, Rep_Ownership_Date__c + 3 + 2 + 2, /* Wed:Rep_Ownership_Date__c +3 day+2 wknd days+2 days */ 3, Rep_Ownership_Date__c + 2 + 2 + 3, /* Wed:Rep_Ownership_Date__c +2 day+2 wknd days+3 days */ 4, Rep_Ownership_Date__c + 1 + 2 + 4, /* Thr:Rep_Ownership_Date__c +1 day+2 wknd days+4 days */ 5, Rep_Ownership_Date__c + 2 + 5, /* Fri:Rep_Ownership_Date__c+2 wknd days+3 days */ 6, Rep_Ownership_Date__c + 1 + 5, /* Sat:Rep_Ownership_Date__c+1 wknd days+5 days */ Rep_Ownership_Date__c + 4 + 2 + 1 /* Default (Mon):Rep_Ownership_Date__c+5day */ )
CustomField.label: Business Day (5th)
